title: Islington Emergency Help Points
summary: Offline guide to emergency medical help points, urgent care, and local hazards in the London Borough of Islington.
content:
For life-threatening emergencies, always dial 999 first (or 112). Call 105 for power cuts and 0800 111 999 for gas leaks.

1. 24-Hour Emergency Hospitals
- Whittington Hospital (24/7 A&E): Magdala Avenue, Archway, N19 5NF. From Archway tube station: ~5 min walk north along Highgate Hill and Dartmouth Park Hill to Magdala Avenue, or bus 143, 210, 263, or 271.
- University College Hospital (24/7 A&E - South/West): 235 Euston Road, NW1 2BU. From Angel station: take Northern Line to King's Cross, then walk ~10 min west along Euston Road, or bus 30 or 73.
- The Royal London Hospital (Major Trauma Centre): Whitechapel Road, E1 1FR.

2. Urgent Treatment Centres
- Whittington Urgent Treatment Centre: Magdala Avenue, N19 5NF. Located in the main entrance area beside the emergency department.
- Angel Urgent Care / St Pancras Hospital Walk-in Centre (Nearby): St Pancras Hospital, 4 St Pancras Way, NW1 0PE.

3. Local Environmental Hazards
- Subterranean Rivers & Surface Runoff: Historical course of River Fleet causes intense surface-water and basement-level flash flooding around Clerkenwell, Farringdon, and lower Holloway during cloudbursts.
- Regent's Canal corridor: Local overflow and water pooling around Angel tunnel portals and King's Cross border basins.

4. Essential Supplies
- Large grocery stores and pharmacies along Upper Street (Angel), Holloway Road (N7), and St John Street (Clerkenwell) supply emergency water containers, sanitation goods, and first-aid supplies.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
